title: Aadhar Card Download | Appointment Book | Update | PVC Order | Etc 2022
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in
2. Login with Aadhaar/VID + OTP
3. Download e-Aadhaar / Order PVC
4. Book appointment or update demographics online
5. Track update status with URN
shortDescription: Aadhaar Card download, update, appointment booking, PVC order – all services on myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in.
content:
UIDAI MyAadhaar portal provides complete Aadhaar lifecycle services:

  • Download e-Aadhaar (PDF)
  • Order PVC Aadhaar card
  • Update name, address, DOB, mobile, email
  • Book Aadhaar Seva Kendra appointment
  • Check enrolment / update status
  • Lock/unlock biometrics

Never share OTP. Official: uidai.gov.in / myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in.

faqs.question: Which Aadhaar services are available through MyAadhaar?
faqs.answer: Common services include e-Aadhaar download, PVC card order, appointment booking, demographic update requests and enrolment or update status tracking.

faqs.question: Is OTP required for online Aadhaar services?
faqs.answer: Many services use an OTP sent to the registered mobile number. Never disclose that OTP, Aadhaar authentication details or payment information to anyone.

faqs.question: Where should Aadhaar services be completed?
faqs.answer: Use the official UIDAI websites myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in and uidai.gov.in, or the official appointment portal linked on this page.

faqs.question: Can every Aadhaar detail be updated online?
faqs.answer: Available online updates depend on UIDAI rules and the service. Some changes may require a visit to an Aadhaar Seva Kendra with supporting documents.
